reason:
Half of it is verified and half of it is wrong; the verified half is real enough to stand.

FAULT 1 — CONFIRMED, measured. owner-empty is field([bar, div.b-empty, foot]). .b-field carries padding 40px 56px 56px at >=701px, and [data-medium=sheet|full] .b-empty (b.css:1291) adds another 56px of its own, so every child of the empty block is inset 56px inside the two hairlines that bracket it. Measured, driven, at six widths: 1440 bar/foot x=186, block children x=242; 1279 105.5 vs 161.5; 1152 and 1024 96 vs 152; 768 96 vs 152; 390 20 vs 20 (phone rule is padding 56px 0 — the fault is desk-only, as claimed). Both hairlines are drawn, so this is not a theoretical box: the rule above and the rule below start at 186 and run to 1254 while the only content on the page starts at 242. Three objects, two left edges.

The sharpest evidence the refuter can add is that it is the SAME ELEMENT moving. .b-who — the project name, identical class, identical string 'Aisling & Tom' — sits at x=186 on owner-flight, owner-editing and owner-undone (flush with bar and foot), and at x=242 on owner-empty. The empty screen's own success path calls go('owner-flight'), so the owner types a date, presses Add a moment, and watches their project name jump 56px to the left. That is a jump between the first two screens a new owner ever sees.

FAULT 2 — REFUTED, and the finding is wrong about its own fix. shell.css:214-229 gives .tl-page background-color:var(--paper) + background-image:linear-gradient(var(--page-wash,var(--ink-04))...), and shell.css:187-196 gives body the IDENTICAL pair. Verified by comparing computed styles at runtime: backgroundColor and backgroundImage match exactly (same:true). There is no seam, no edge, no 'stage ends at 796.9' anyone can see — the ground below the page is the same ground. Worse, the proposed fix does not do what it says. Adding owner-empty to the min-height list at shell.css:246-249 adds min-height only; justify-content stays flex-start, so the foot does not move one pixel and 'the foot lands on the bottom of the window exactly as it does in the five states' is false — in those five states the foot lands there because of justify-content:safe center on the OTHER rule (235-245), which round 6 deliberately withheld from print and owner surfaces. The only version of this fix that produces the described result is the one that collides head-on with round 6's scoping. And at 1024/1152/1279 x 800 the page is already 837px tall — taller than the window — so there is no dead ground to reclaim at three of the six widths measured.

WHY THE FIX IS SAFE AND AN IMPROVEMENT (driven, injected as an override, not edited). padding:110px 0 120px puts .b-who, .b-emptyTitle, .b-emptyBody, the label/field/button row and the hint on 186 at 1440, 96 at 768/1024/1152, 161.5 at 1279 — the exact edge of the bar and the foot. Nothing else moves: bar, foot, field and page boxes are unchanged, docH is unchanged (960/1024/837). It also fixes a second thing for free: at 768 the heading currently wraps to two lines in the 464px it is left with (h=135.7) and sets on one line in 576px (h=67.8). And on the second variant — after the day is set — the count numeral lands at x=179 with .b-who at 186, which is pixel-for-pixel where owner-flight puts .b-num (179) and .b-who (186). The fix makes the empty screen's left edge identical to the screen it turns into.

GATES: no assertion touches this. The centring assertions (interaction-check.mjs:650-667, 2102-2116) cover publish/day/ended/loading/unfurl only; the only geometry assertion naming owner-empty is the phone side-padding check (line 213), which reads .b-field (20px on phone), not .b-empty. Palette, weights and type are untouched.

Not taste: it is one element on two left edges with two visible rules to measure it against, and the same element on a different edge one press later.
sharpenedFix: Take the first half only; drop the second. In b.css:1291 change [data-medium="sheet"] .b-empty, [data-medium="full"] .b-empty { padding: 110px 56px 120px } to { padding: 110px 0 120px } — verified at 390/768/1024/1152/1279/1440 to put every child of the empty block on the bar's and foot's own left edge, to move nothing else, and to un-wrap the heading at 768. If a measure is wanted on the heading now that it is 1068px wide at 1440, add max-width to .b-emptyTitle rather than re-introducing padding, so the left edge stays put. Do NOT add owner-empty to the min-height list: page and body paint the identical ground so there is nothing to see, min-height without justify-content moves the foot nowhere, and the version that would move it is the vertical centring round 6 deliberately kept off owner surfaces. Consider whether the twin rule [data-medium="sheet"] .b-empty's neighbour at b.css:1293 — .b-ended, padding 100px 56px 110px — has the same problem; it does not today only because the ended state renders at medium=card, where the rule never fires.
